Lexkite – English learning app (IELTS · TOEIC · TOEFL · CEFR) shipped in 15 UI languages incl. German, Russian, Vietnamese, Arabic (RTL): design every label for +40% longer text, wrap instead of truncating, never shrink buttons. Use the project design system (Lexkite Kit / Tactile Gamified Prep): Plus Jakarta Sans, deep teal #0F3D3E brand, coral CTA with tactile bottom ledge, cream light background, rounded 16-24px cards. App shell: mobile bottom tab bar with exactly 5 tabs Today, Vocab, Skills, Tests, Me; desktop left sidebar with the same 5 items. No hearts or lives anywhere. No photos and no drawn people: where the teacher appears, leave an empty rounded placeholder labelled "teacher-slot" (the 2D teacher Ama or Carlos is inserted by code). Material Symbols Rounded icons. Every tap target at least 44x44 px, text contrast at least 4.5:1, icons at least 3:1. Realistic content, no lorem ipsum.

Screen (mobile 390px, light theme): the IELTS Speaking practice room, before recording, an INNER screen (back arrow 44 px + title, no bottom tabs). Title "Speaking room". A segmented control with three parts "Part 1 · Interview", "Part 2 · Long turn", "Part 3 · Discussion" (Part 1 selected) and a topic picker row showing "Education" with a small dice button "Random topic". A question card: chip "Short questions about you - answer in 2-3 sentences (about 20-40 s)", the question "Do you prefer studying alone or with other people?", "Question 2/3", a secondary button with a speaker icon "Hear the examiner" and a quiet button "Next question". Below, a big round coral microphone button centered under a calm "00:00" timer and the hint "Tap the microphone to answer · Goal: 20-40 seconds". Then a "Useful words" card with 3 vocabulary rows (word, short meaning, a speaker icon button and a plus-to-flashcards icon button) and a "Part 1 tips" card with 3 short tips. Feel: like a friendly examiner room, calm and unhurried, not an exam panic. Quality bar (hard): every text at least 4.5:1 contrast in this theme (no light-grey or low-opacity small text, no white text on light chips); every button, link, chip, icon button and input at least 44 px tall with clear spacing; icons only from the Material Symbols set with real names; no horizontal overflow at 390 px; in the dark theme no white or very light cards or panels. Frame (Lexkite §5d): phone 390 px; top bar is one of three fixed variants – hub screen: title left + one icon action right, with the 5 bottom tabs; inner screen: back arrow (44 px) + title, no bottom tabs; lesson/focus screen: close X (44 px) top left + slim progress bar, no tabs, one full-width primary button pinned at the bottom. 16 px side gutter, one primary button per screen.
